description: The box's gate lock (VAZÃO F23): scripts/deliver holds an exclusive flock on this file while its gate runs, and scripts/test-suite while a whole suite runs, so the deliveries of several lanes on one box queue for the CPU instead of sharing it (three concurrent suites took 346 s each against 113 s alone, with failures under load). Outside every checkout, so every worktree and clone of the box shares it.
